# Brandex Community & Education Platform

> Brandex is an open technology education, developer community, and engineering cohort platform founded to bridge the gap between academic theory and practical technology development.

## Official Portal & Parent Ecosystem
- Official Website: https://www.brandex.co.in/

## Technology & Education Disciplines
1. Artificial Intelligence & Agent Systems: Autonomous agent architecture, LLM fine-tuning, RAG frameworks, model evaluation.
2. Cybersecurity & Defense: Zero-trust architecture, capture-the-flag (CTF) wargames, defensive hardening, network auditing.
3. High School & Youth (Geniusphere Series): Algorithmic logic, robotics foundation, web prototyping for secondary schools.
4. Distributed Systems & Concurrency: High-throughput backend design, WebAssembly, concurrent pipelines.
5. Swiss & Digital UX Design: Information architecture, responsive interfaces, micro-interactions.
